summary: Iteration 9 (useFocusEffect refetch bug fix) — FRONTEND-ONLY verification. Bug fully resolved. E2E on mobile 390x844 viewport against public URL: (1) Contracts list refetches on focus — created 'TEST_FocusV3_Contract' via 'Nuevo' form, returned to /contracts, list count went 17→18 and the new contract appears at the top. (2) Dashboard 'Recent' also refetches — same contract appears in /(tabs)/index after focus. (3) Contract detail refetches on focus — added 'TEST_Adenda_V3_focus' via 'Agregar Adenda', returned to detail via router.back(), Addenda (1) section immediately shows the new addendum without pull-to-refresh. (4) Evidence tab renders with FAB (structural check). All 4 files (contracts.tsx, index.tsx, evidence.tsx, contract/[id]/index.tsx) correctly import useFocusEffect from expo-router and wrap load() with useFocusEffect(useCallback(...)). Regression: dashboard bell → notifications still works (previous iteration fix intact). No backend regression tests run this iteration (frontend-only scope), but API calls behind the scenes succeeded (POST /api/contracts, POST /api/contracts/:id/addendum, GET /api/contracts, GET /api/dashboard all responded correctly as evidenced by UI state).

critical_code_review_comments: useFocusEffect implementation is correct in all 4 files: (a) uses useCallback with load in deps, (b) imported from expo-router (not @react-navigation/native — both work, expo-router re-exports it). (c) contract/[id]/index.tsx keeps BOTH useEffect(load) and useFocusEffect(load) — this is redundant since useFocusEffect fires on initial focus too. Recommend removing the useEffect and keeping only useFocusEffect to avoid a double-fetch on mount. Reference: /app/frontend/app/contract/[id]/index.tsx:39-42.

The load() callback in each screen sets setLoading(true) inside useFocusEffect only in contracts.tsx; other screens do not toggle loading on refocus, so a stale value flashes briefly — acceptable UX but consider consistency.

rca_of_issue: RCA: Before fix, list screens used `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load])` which only fires on mount. Expo Router with a bottom Tabs layout keeps mounted screens alive when switching tabs, and returning from a stacked child screen via router.back() does NOT remount the parent — so load() never fired again and the newly-created contract/addendum stayed absent from the UI even though the backend had it. Fix: replace with useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { load(); }, [load])) which fires every time the screen gains focus. Verified end-to-end: created contracts appear in /contracts and dashboard Recent, and a new addendum appears in the parent contract's Addenda section — all without manual pull-to-refresh.
